author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX launch of the 12th flight of Starship from Starbase, Texas. 

Launch Window: May 19th from 5:30PM to 7PM CDT (22:30-00:00 UTC)
Current T0: May 19th at 5:30PM CDT (22:30 UTC).

Mission: Starship's twelfth integrated flight test. Debut mission for Starship version 3
Launch Location: Pad 2, Starbase, Earth
Target orbit: Transatmospheric
Booster: B19-1
Ship: S39-1
Booster recovery: Expended - Water splashdown on the Gulf
Ship recovery: Expended - Water splashdown on the Indian Ocean
Rocket trajectory: Southeast, passing in between Cuba and the Yucatan Peninsula
Payload onboard: 22 Starlink simulators, including 2 fitted with cameras
Payload mass: 28 to 44 metric tons, depending on the exact mass of each satellite. 
Stats:
  - SpaceX's 670th launch overall
  - SpaceX's 61st launch of the year
  - SpaceX's 9th launch of the month
  - Starship's 12th launch overall
  - SpaceX's 1st launch from Pad 2 at Starbase

Starship News Articles: 
https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/?s=Starship

title: SpaceX Starship Flight 12 - Stakeout Stream

author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX has completed a full-duration, full-thrust 33-engine static fire on Booster 19, stacked Ship 39 on top to create the first-ever fully stacked Block 3 Starship, and carried out a major Wet Dress Rehearsal ahead of Flight 12.

In this week’s Starship Update, we cover:
• Booster 19’s successful full-thrust static fire
• The first full Version 3 Starship stack
• Ship 39 rollout and stacking
• Flight 12 Wet Dress Rehearsal attempts
• Pad 2 testing and chopstick repairs
• Ship 40 cryogenic testing at Massey’s
• Gigabay and Starfactory progress
• LC-39A developments in Florida
• Raptor 3 engine production at McGregor

With Flight 12 drawing closer, SpaceX’s rapid pace of operations continues to accelerate.
